name: M4A1
tagline: The Counter-Terrorists' balanced carbine, with a detachable silencer.
summary: The M4A1 is the Counter-Terrorist exclusive assault rifle of Original mode, described by the wiki as the best CT rifle thanks to its balance of damage and accuracy. It fires 30 rounds of 5.56 NATO, has low recoil and good long-range accuracy, and can mount a silencer that hides muzzle flash and sound at the cost of some firepower.
description: The M4A1 (Maverick M4A1 Carbine) is a 30-round 5.56 NATO carbine exclusive to Counter-Terrorists in Original mode. The wiki calls it the best assault rifle among Counter-Terrorists due to its fair balance between damage and accuracy: medium damage, good long-range accuracy and low recoil. Its silencer attachment reduces muzzle flash and firing sound and improves recoil control, but lowers firepower and long-range accuracy. Compared with the AK-47 it deals 2 points less damage, costs $600 more and reloads about 0.5 seconds slower, which is why the wiki considers it less recommended for Scenario modes. Tactical advice from the wiki: aim for the head at close range, burst at the chest at medium range and single-tap the torso at long range; it is optimal for middle-to-close combat.
